content: Google Map Search Results Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000052778 Overview The Google Map Search Results add-on will allow the website to have search results on the front-end of the website displayed on an interactive Google Map. By default the website displays search results for members, posts and more in a list layout. With this add-on, choose to display these search results on an interactive Google Map. How To Get This Add-On Websites with the VIP Add-Ons Club automatically have this add-on available: Join The VIP Add-Ons Club Purchase Individually: Google Map Search Results Add-On Enabling the Add-On 1. Go to Settings - Design Settings. Within the Design Settings tab, scroll down until the admin sees the Search Results Pages option: 2. Expand and make sure to enable it here: The Member Search Results will all display in "Map View": For more information, please submit a ticket HERE . For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate?
